component.name: Pomodoro98
component.summary: Focus timer with a Windows 98-inspired interface

description.p: Pomodoro98 is a lightweight focus timer styled after classic Windows 98 applications. It provides focused work and rest sessions without a distracting interface.

ul.li: Pause and resume sessions without losing time
Track progress in the window title and progress bar
Use optional sounds and a system tray indicator
Continue working when optional integrations are unavailable

screenshot.caption: Pomodoro98 ready to begin a focus session

description.p: First release with the new calendar versioning.

ul.li: The timer keeps accurate time and keeps counting while the computer is suspended.
A wider window, with the mode or "Paused" shown in the window title.
The bell sounds when no audio device can play the alert.
